entities.name: Isona Maive
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Aykan whose specialty is prismatic magic, amplifying the magic of others.

entities.name: Aykan
entities.description: Isona's home plane, deep-frozen for decades.

entities.name: Marit Lage
entities.description: Power bound within the ice on Aykan that Isona tried to harness.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker necromancer who became Isona's savior.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought Isona for her amplification powers.

entities.name: Battle of Amonkhet
entities.description: Battle in which Liliana played a role.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where doom weavers imprisoned Isona.

entities.name: Doom weavers
entities.description: Pack that imprisoned Isona in an underground cocoon.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Spell Tezzeret planned to cast by gathering mana.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: Shut down Tezzeret's machine and freed Isona.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: Planeswalker whose plane Isona fled to.

events.summary: Isona tries to harness Marit Lage's power to heal Aykan, but amplifies the enchantment binding Lage, deep-freezing Aykan, its inhabitants and herself for decades.
events.quote: This resulted in her deep-freezing Aykan, all its inhabitants, and herself for decades.

events.summary: Tezzeret seeks Isona for her amplification powers.
events.quote: Tezzeret sought Isona for her amplification powers

events.summary: Isona agrees to help Tezzeret siphon Marit Lage's power, with Liliana's death as payment.
events.quote: she agreed, believing he would help her heal Aykan

events.summary: Liliana leads Isona to Innistrad, where doom weavers imprison her in an underground cocoon for decades.
events.quote: a pack of doom weavers imprisoned her in an underground cocoon for the next few decades

events.summary: Tezzeret activates his machine; Davriel Cane shuts it down and Isona cuts Tezzeret off from the aether.
events.quote: Isona cut off Tezzeret's connection to the aether, leaving him powerless

events.summary: Davriel frees Isona, who flees to Aminatou's plane to alter fate.
events.quote: Davriel freed her from the siphoning cables

relations.note: befriended her savior, later shunned her

relations.quote: Isona cut off Tezzeret's connection to the aether
Davriel freed her from the siphoning cables
